{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0566","text":"Sorry, forwarding again because I think the first one went to spam?? Please confirm you can make it, I'm really worried we'll lose our top candidate if we wait.

---------- Forwarded invite ----------
Volunteer Coordinator Interview Debrief
Thu 7:00-7:30pm, Zoom
To: Omar Abernathy, Xavier Ekwueme, Victor Gallo, Marcus Zapata, Paloma Underhill, Jada Varga

Rough plan:
- Quick round of impressions on the 2 candidates
* Pick one (or decide to re-post)
- Who calls them
  - Compass migration update from Victor (sign-up sheets)
* treasurer report recap??

> Omar: Only Jada and I actually sat in on the interviews. Do the rest of us need to be there?
> Jada: Agree w/ Omar, honestly 10 min between the two of us + Nico would do it. Compass stuff can go in the newsletter thread.
> Marcus: happy to skip if that's ok"},{"spec_id":"spec_0567","text":"Subject: Postmortem: donor data exposure on Project Zephyr, Tue 10-11am

Hi all,

First, I'm sorry. Last Thursday's Project Zephyr mailing went out with the wrong merge file. Roughly 1,200 donors got a letter that showed another donor's giving amount. That's on our process, and I own the part where I approved the send.

I'd like the full group of 15 together for an hour on Tuesday, 10-11am, in the Main Room (dial-in: [link]). Comms, data, development, and the two board liaisons all need to be in the room. The fixes cut across teams, and we need to agree on them together, not by email.

Rough agenda:
- Timeline walk-through (Nadia, 10 min). The draft is here: [link]
- Where the checks failed. Open discussion, no blame.
- Decide: do we notify affected donors individually, and who signs it?
- Decide: what changes to the merge/approval workflow, owners and dates
- Board communication (Uriel and Pilar)

Please read the timeline beforehand and add comments if anything's wrong. Yasmin has the vendor's account of events and will share it in the doc by Monday.

Logistics, sorry to bundle these: the lot behind the building is being repaved Tuesday, so park on Elm. Soren is bringing lunch after for anyone who can stay. And it's Ines's birthday, so there will be cake, which feels oddly timed but she deserves it.

Thank you for your patience with this. I know it's been a rough week.

Delia"},{"spec_id":"spec_0568","text":"FYI, all GMs please attend. Attendance is mandatory.

--- Forwarded ---
Atlas 2.0 POS Go-Live Briefing
Mon 3:00-4:00pm, Conference Line
24 invitees

Liam will present the new date for switch over, the training schedule per location, and who is contact for each region. Slides will be sending after.

-Yusuf"},{"spec_id":"spec_0569","text":"Title: Spring Fundraiser Brainstorm, Kestrel initiative 🌷
When: Wednesday, 6:30-7:30pm
Where: School library (or Zoom, link in the PTA group chat)
Invited: PTA committee (9)

Hi friends!

Let's come together and brainstorm for the Kestrel initiative fundraiser! I already collected everyone's ideas from the survey last week, so here is how we will go through them:

1. Tess: shares the 3 most voted ideas (bake sale, fun run, silent auction) and the numbers from the survey
2. Soren: tells what the budget from last year was and what is left
3. Hector: reports the date options the principal approved (April 12 or 19)
4. Beth: reads the list of volunteers who already signed up for each idea
5. Fern: explains rules from district about raffles (short version, they are not allowed anymore 😅)
6. Uriel: shares the timeline for flyers to go home in backpacks

After this, I will put everything in one summary doc so we all have it.

Some other things:
- Parking by the gym is closed for the evening because of the basketball game, please use the front lot
- Fern's birthday is Thursday! I bring cupcakes 🎂
- Kids are welcome, there will be coloring in corner

Please make sure to read the survey results before, they are in the shared folder. If you can't come, no problem, I will send notes after!

Thanks so much everyone, you are the best!!
Uma"},{"spec_id":"spec_0570","text":"Subject: Opal rollout retro, Fri 2pm?

Hey Maeve, Ximena, Kemi,

Opal's out, mostly smoothly 🎉 But the staging hiccup and the late QA handoff are worth unpacking together before we start Q3 planning. Let's do 45 min Friday at 2. Bring one thing that worked and one that didn't.

Zoe"}]}
